evidence.quote: To address the source complexity and make full use of the high-resolution images, we employ spatially resolved spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting on a pixel-by-pixel basis

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Major merger, minor merger and violent disk instability considered; major merger and VDI disfavoured

evidence.quote: By disfavouring a direct major merger event, the next likely process is ongoing minor merging.

limitations_admitted.value: Gas-to-dust ratio from another galaxy; depletion-time variations likely within uncertainties

evidence.quote: we caution that these variations in depletion time are likely to be within the uncertainties

limitations_admitted.value: S/N limited the 3DBarolo fit (centre fixed), and dispersion is modelled less precisely

evidence.quote: Due to our S/N limitations, we fixed the RA and Dec of the model
while dispersion was modeled with less precision due to the challenging nature of modeling it accurately.

limitations_admitted.value: Dust continuum could not be included in SED fitting because only one FIR band

evidence.quote: We did not include the dust continuum because it is hard to derive an accurate FIR model with only one band.

referee_caveats_inferred: Table 2 gives tau_depl = 73 +/- 10 Myr while the text and abstract give ~120 Myr; the two are not reconciled
Vrot/sigma_gas is ~5 in the Conclusions but ~4 in the Discussion; no uncertainties are given
SFR is derived from CO(5-4) via a L_TIR-L'CO relation with 0.2 dex scatter, so the SFR maps are indirect; the Table 2 SFR (626) differs from Herschel (533)
Gas mass relies on a single-band Rayleigh-Jeans-like dust estimate with an assumed T_dust (33 K), a 500 micron kappa and a gas-to-dust ratio from another galaxy
Stellar mass maps depend on a simple six-band SED model with fixed solar metallicity
No ALMA calibration, self-calibration or tclean details are given, limiting exact reproduction

products_in_archive.value: ALMA data release products referenced for line-flagging; archive project 2016.1.01426.S named

evidence.quote: centered at the line centroid in the dirty cubes, based on the ALMA data release products
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.01426.S.

missing_for_reproduction: Full tclean parameters (cell, image size, scales, thresholds, masks), line-free channel list and self-calibration
3DBarolo input parameter file and ring setup
bagpipes/pixedfit priors and sampler settings, PSFs and binning maps
COSMOS-Web reduced JWST images (reduction by Franco et al. in preparation)
Luminosity distance and the exact pixel-wise L'CO and dust-mass implementations
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Two Band 6 configurations (about 1.5 h and 22 min on source) plus public JWST/HST images; roughly tens of GB of ALMA raw data and a few GB of images
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA project code and many numerical results given with clear steps, but ALMA calibration/tclean settings, 3DBarolo configuration and SED priors are missing, the JWST reduction is unpublished, and Table 2 and the text disagree on depletion time
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state data are public and the recipe omits key calibration, imaging and fitting settings; several results depend on unpublished or external inputs

companion_papers.why: Same ALMA program and gas-to-dust ratio
CO(2-1) detection, Herschel SFR and gas mass of PACS-819
